name: POS Order Type
description: The Order Type in Point of Sale module enhances POS by enabling businesses to classify and manage sales orders based on predefined order types such as Dine-In, Takeaway, Delivery, or Service.
summary: The Order Type in Point of Sale module is designed to enhance the functionality of Odoo’s POS system by introducing the ability to categorize and manage sales orders based on their type. name: POS Complimentary Product
description: This module enhances Point of Sale by enabling automatic addition of complimentary products to orders. It simplifies promotional offers by linking free items with selected products, reducing manual effort at checkout.
summary: The POS Complimentary Products module enhances Odoo’s Point of Sale by automating promotional offers with complimentary (free) items. Instead of relying on cashiers to manually add free products during checkout, the app automatically applies them whenever the defined rules are met. With flexible configuration options, businesses can enable the feature in POS settings and assign complimentary products directly from the product form. Quantity thresholds and offer limits provide greater control, making promotions like “Buy 5, Get 1 Free” simple to manage. Complimentary products are clearly displayed in POS order lines and on printed receipts, ensuring full visibility and transparency for customers. This automation not only improves the customer experience but also saves cashier time, reduces errors, and guarantees consistent application of promotional campaigns. The module is ideal for retailers, supermarkets, and restaurants looking to run Odoo POS promotions such as free products, loyalty offers, or buy-one-get-one deals. By automating promotional items in POS, businesses can boost sales, strengthen customer loyalty, and simplify their marketing efforts. name: POS Product Quantity Limit
description: Odoo Point of Sale product sales limits prevent overselling and manage product scarcity by letting you set maximum purchase quantities per customer, directly within your POS system.
summary: The Limit Product Sales in POS module for Odoo helps businesses prevent overselling and manage product scarcity by setting maximum purchase quantities per customer. With product-wise or category-wise limits, you can restrict how many units can be sold in each transaction. If the limit is exceeded, the POS system automatically blocks the order and displays a warning message. This ensures fair distribution, better inventory control, and compliance with sales policies directly within your POS system. This module is especially useful for managing scarce items, promotional products, and regulated goods where strict purchase limits are required. Whenever a cashier tries to sell more than the configured limit, the system automatically validates the order and prevents it from being confirmed, displaying a clear warning message on the POS screen. By applying these restrictions, businesses can maintain better inventory management, ensure fair distribution of high-demand items, and avoid compliance issues related to overselling. With this feature, you can easily define maximum sales quantities per product or product category, ensuring that no customer can purchase more than the allowed amount during a transaction.
